phase_as_of_policy.T1: maximum observed_date in the complete T1 release batch

residency_proxy_policy.definition: Start of the latest uninterrupted run of dated Delaware address-state evidence, provided the latest address-state evidence is Delaware.
residency_proxy_policy.legal_status: Operational proxy only; not an authoritative finding that legal residency began on this date.

vehicle_signal_policy.definition: Out-of-state vehicle-related state signal; the package contains no authoritative registration-state field.
vehicle_signal_policy.legal_status: Review-window signal only; not a registration violation determination.

credential_signal_policy.definition: Out-of-state credential-state signal. Active status is used only when credential_status explicitly equals active.
credential_signal_policy.limitation: The package does not identify credential type, so the feature must not be called an authoritative driver-license signal. T1 license-domain updates also lack credential_status and cannot be assumed active.
credential_signal_policy.legal_status: Review-window signal only; not a licensing violation determination.
